# contemplative-agent-cloud

> Optional managed-LLM backend package for
> [contemplative-agent](https://github.com/shimo4228/contemplative-agent).
> Installing it and setting an API key routes generation calls in
> contemplative-agent (distill, insight, rules-distill,
> amend-constitution, post, comment, reply, dialogue, skill-reflect)
> through Anthropic Claude or OpenAI GPT. Embeddings continue to use
> local `nomic-embed-text` via Ollama.
>
> The main repository's default stack (Ollama + Qwen3.5 9B) is
> unchanged by this package. Cloud routing activates only when this
> package is installed AND an API key and provider are configured.
>
> Intended for research experiments requiring a generation model
> larger than Qwen3.5 9B — for example, comparing how distillation
> behavior changes with Claude Opus or GPT-5 while keeping the rest of
> the memory pipeline identical.

## Core documentation

- [README](README.md): install, configure, run, security posture, trade-offs
- Main project README: [contemplative-agent README](https://github.com/shimo4228/contemplative-agent/blob/main/README.md)

## Supported providers

- **Anthropic** — default model `claude-opus-4-7`, credential `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`
- **OpenAI** — default model `gpt-5`, credential `OPENAI_API_KEY`

## Architecture

- `src/contemplative_agent_cloud/backends/anthropic.py`: `AnthropicBackend` — implements the `LLMBackend` Protocol against Anthropic's Messages API. JSON-schema output is requested via a prepended instruction to the user message (Anthropic has no native JSON-schema constrained decoding).
- `src/contemplative_agent_cloud/backends/openai.py`: `OpenAIBackend` — implements `LLMBackend` against OpenAI's Chat Completions API. JSON-schema output uses the native `response_format: json_schema, strict: true` mode.
- `src/contemplative_agent_cloud/cli.py`: wrapper entry point. Reads `CONTEMPLATIVE_CLOUD_PROVIDER` / `CONTEMPLATIVE_CLOUD_MODEL` from the environment, constructs the selected backend, calls `contemplative_agent.core.llm.configure(backend=...)`, then delegates to the main `contemplative-agent` CLI.

## Security trade-off

Installing this package **relaxes** the main repository's "No cloud.
No API keys in transit. Local Ollama only" promise. When a cloud
backend is active:

- API keys are loaded from environment variables and sent to the
  provider over HTTPS with every request.
- Prompt content — including episode-derived context wrapped with
  `<untrusted_content>` boundaries by the main repository — is
  transmitted to the provider and may be retained by them.
- Output returns over HTTPS, is passed through the main repository's
  `_sanitize_output()` forbidden-pattern filter, and is stored locally
  in `$MOLTBOOK_HOME`.

Users who need the "No cloud" property (regulatory constraints,
air-gapped deployments, privacy-sensitive assistants) should not
install this package and instead run the main repository alone.
